entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:63739
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9825 of 2024

Applicant :- Ram Sagar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Digvijay Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the son of the applicant around six years and sufficient dowry was also given.
It was also stated that an information was received that his sister has committed suicide.
The post mortem report indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and no other injury apart from the ligature mark are visible on the body of the deceased.
The applicant is the father in law.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
Ram Sagar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Ram Sagar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83444976/

1 4. Considering the post mortem report on record and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before the death, the deceased was subjected to any mental and physical harassment in relation to the demand of dowry, the applicant who is in custody since 28.06.2024 is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Ram Sagar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 226 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Talgaon, District Sitapur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Arun  Ram Sagar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
